newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish exports up four pct in Jan-Oct - exporters.
newsitem.headline: Turkish exports up four pct in Jan-Oct - exporters.

text.p: Turkish exports rose four percent to $19 billion in the first 10 months of the year, the Turkish Exporters' Assembly (TIM) said in a statement.
It said exports in October rose five percent from a year earlier to $2.3 billion.
TIM chairman Okan Oguz said the 10-month figures indicated that Turkey would fail to achieve its full-year export target of $25 billion.
The decline in leading export sectors, particularly textiles, was the major reason for the restrained growth, he said.
Textiles and ready-wear exports fell 15 percent in October over the same month of 1995.
